name: llmc_adamw
goal: Port adamw_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/adamw.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1, 2] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> N T` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 0.0001 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: migrate's output under migrated/ counts, so delete it (delete_file) once your own port is done. migrate's output can be long: read it in parts (read_file offset/limit) or work from the CUDA harness.

museport.note: N=1048576, T=10 as in llm.c; kept full size (4x4MB inputs, 3x4MB outputs, well under 200MB and fast on CPU). Defaults for lr/betas/eps/weight_decay as in main.
